title: 第5章 还是修仙更胜一筹第6章 聚灵符
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
安东并不知道达里安三人的心思，此时他的心神完全沉浸在了体内。
灵识扫描之下，体内一应细节一览无余。
一道散发着淡淡微光的光痕正盘踞在他精神海深处，不断吸收着周围的元素能量，将其压缩、储存下来。
“原来如此，这就是魔力。”
亲自参与了凝聚魔力的过程后，安东对这种本土能量有了更深的认知。
凝聚魔力，说开了其实就是吸收、压缩和储存元素能量的物理过程。
魔力本质就是密度更高的元素能量，二者仍属同种能量。
而灵气不同。
修仙的灵气炼化，更像是一个化学过程。
修士将天地能量纳入体内，经由功法的复杂转化，剔除杂质，凝练升华，最终形成独属于自己的本命灵气。
灵气与天地能量已非同质，而是带有修士独特印记的、更加精纯高阶的能量。
打个比方，如果说魔力是‘元素原液’，那么灵气就是‘元素精华液’。
更别说太初灵气还是最上乘的灵气之一。
两者的能量密度简直天差地别。
“我的身体既然能容纳灵气，就肯定能容纳得下同等数量的魔力，只要灵气总量上来了，扩张魔力回路就是水到渠成的事。”
“还是修仙体系更胜一筹啊。”
安东感叹一声，旋即从冥想状态中退出。
刚睁开眼，他就看到三双眼睛正目不转睛地盯着自己，神色各异。
埃蒙和布莱登是毫不掩饰的羡慕与震惊。
达里安则在惊叹之余，眼底还藏着几分欣慰与惊喜。

“老师......”
安东很清楚自己冥想第一天就构筑出魔力回路有多么惊世骇俗，张口就要解释，却被达里安笑呵呵地打断。
“没想到我们银月氏族会出一个超魔体质的天才，三位长老知道了，肯定十分高兴。”
超魔体质？
安东疑惑地眨了眨眼，那又是什么？
见安东满脸不解，达里安笑着解释了一遍。
听罢，安东满心错愕。
他可不记得游戏里有这种设定，是真实的晨曦大陆才有的隐藏细节？
看来以后不能仅凭对游戏的了解来判断现实了，这个世界的真实远比游戏数据复杂得多。
不过这样也好，安东原本打算找个‘私底下偷偷冥想过了’的理由，大不了违反氏族规矩被关一段时间禁闭，现在倒是省了不少功夫。
“看来立个天才人设也有好处。”安东心中暗忖，“就算以后身上出现什么异常，也可以推到这上面去。”
见安东呆愣在原地，达里安还以为他是太过惊喜，便笑着拍拍他的肩膀。
“历来拥有超魔体质的施法者，只要不中途夭折，未来成就基本都不会太低。”
“不过你也不要太骄傲，超魔体质只是让你在魔力积累上拥有比别人更多的优势，但在魔法上，你跟其他人还是同一起跑线，今后也要脚踏实地修炼。”
达里安看了眼窗外的天色，“时间不早了，今天课就上到这里，接下来一段时间你好好巩固魔力，等魔力稳定后，我就正式教你学习魔法。”
“是，老师。”安东应了一声，突然话锋一转，“老师，我有个问题想请教您一下。”
“你说。”达里安微笑道。
“施法者绘制卷轴，一般用什么材料？”
达里安微微一怔：“你怎么会想起问这个？”
content_en:
Anton didn't know what Darien and the three were thinking, and at this time, his mind was completely immersed in his body.
Under the scanning of spiritual consciousness, every detail in the body can be seen at a glance.
A faint trace of light was entrenched in the depths of his spiritual sea, constantly absorbing the surrounding elemental energy, compressing and storing it.
"I see, this is magic."
After personally participating in the process of condensing magic power, Anton has a deeper understanding of this local energy.
Condensing magic power is actually a physical process of absorbing, compressing and storing elemental energy.
The essence of magic is elemental energy with higher density, and the two are still the same kind of energy.
But aura is different.
The refining of spiritual energy in cultivating immortals is more like a chemical process.
The monks take the energy of heaven and earth into their bodies, remove impurities, condense and sublimate them through complex transformations of the exercises, and finally form their own unique spiritual energy.
Spiritual energy is no longer the same as the energy of heaven and earth, but a purer and higher-level energy that bears the unique mark of a monk.
For example, if magic is the 'element liquid', then aura is the 'element essence'.
Not to mention that Taichu’s spiritual energy is still one of the most superior spiritual energy.
The energy density of the two is completely different.
"Since my body can hold spiritual energy, it can definitely hold the same amount of magic power. As long as the total amount of spiritual energy increases, expanding the magic circuit will be a matter of course."
"The system of cultivating immortals is still better."
Anton sighed and immediately exited the meditative state.
As soon as he opened his eyes, he saw three pairs of eyes staring at him intently, with different expressions.
Eamonn and Brendan were unabashedly envious and shocked.
Darien was amazed, but there was also a bit of relief and surprise in his eyes.
"Teacher..."
Anton knew very well how shocking it was to construct a magic circuit on the first day of meditation. He opened his mouth to explain, but was interrupted by Darien with a smile.
"I didn't expect that our Silver Moon clan would produce a genius with a super-demon physique. The three elders will definitely be very happy when they know about it."
Super magical physique?
Anton blinked in confusion, what was that?
Seeing Anton's puzzled face, Darien smiled and explained.
After hearing this, Anton was shocked.
Doesn't he remember that there is such a setting in the game, a hidden detail that only exists in the real Dawn Continent?
It seems that in the future, we can no longer judge reality based on our understanding of the game. The reality of this world is far more complicated than game data.
But that's okay. Anton originally planned to find an excuse for "meditating secretly in private". At worst, he would be imprisoned for a period of time for violating clan rules, but now he saves a lot of effort.
"It seems that there are benefits to establishing a genius character." Anton thought to himself, "Even if there is any abnormality in the future, it can be attributed to this."
Seeing Anton stunned in place, Darien thought he was too surprised, so he smiled and patted his shoulder.
"As long as spellcasters with super-magic physiques don't die prematurely, their future achievements will basically not be too low."
"But don't be too proud. The super-magic physique only gives you more advantages than others in terms of magic power accumulation. But in terms of magic, you and others are still starting from the same starting point. You must practice down-to-earth in the future."
Darien glanced at the sky outside the window and said, "It's getting late. That's the end of today's class. In the next period of time, you should consolidate your magic power. Once the magic power is stable, I will officially teach you how to learn magic."
"Yes, teacher." Anton responded and suddenly changed the topic, "Teacher, I have a question to ask you."
"You said it." Darien smiled.
"What materials do casters generally use to draw scrolls?"
Darien was slightly startled: "Why do you think of asking this?"
